erefs.l: Proximal esophagus - Edema [0 = Absent; 1 = Present - loss of normal vascular markings, pallor or decreased transparency]. Contributes up to 1 point in this region.
Proximal esophagus - Rings [0 = Absent; 1 = Mild; 2 = Moderate; 3 = Severe]. Contributes up to 3 points in this region.
Proximal esophagus - Exudates [0 = Absent; 1 = Mild - under 10% of the mucosal surface; 2 = Severe - 10% or more of the mucosal surface]. Contributes up to 2 points in this region.
Proximal esophagus - Furrows [0 = Absent; 1 = Mild; 2 = Severe]. Contributes up to 2 points in this region.
Proximal esophagus - Stricture [0 = Absent; 1 = Present]. Contributes up to 1 point in this region.
Distal esophagus - Edema [0 = Absent; 1 = Present - loss of normal vascular markings, pallor or decreased transparency]. Contributes up to 1 point in this region.
Distal esophagus - Rings [0 = Absent; 1 = Mild; 2 = Moderate; 3 = Severe]. Contributes up to 3 points in this region.
Distal esophagus - Exudates [0 = Absent; 1 = Mild - under 10% of the mucosal surface; 2 = Severe - 10% or more of the mucosal surface]. Contributes up to 2 points in this region.
Distal esophagus - Furrows [0 = Absent; 1 = Mild; 2 = Severe]. Contributes up to 2 points in this region.
Distal esophagus - Stricture [0 = Absent; 1 = Present]. Contributes up to 1 point in this region.

erez-dic.l: Platelet count [Below 50 x10^9/L = 1; 50 to 100 x10^9/L = 2; Above 100 to 185 x10^9/L = 1; Above 185 x10^9/L = 0]. NON-MONOTONIC as published: below 50 scores fewer points than 50 to 100.

Prothrombin time DIFFERENCE IN SECONDS: the patient value MINUS the laboratory control. NOT a ratio and NOT an INR - passing either adds 25 unearned points [Below 0.5 seconds = 0; 0.5 to 1.0 seconds = 5; Above 1.0 to 1.5 seconds = 12; Above 1.5 seconds = 25]
Fibrinogen [Below 3.0 g/L = 25; 3.0 to 4.0 g/L = 6; Above 4.0 to 4.5 g/L = 1; Above 4.5 g/L = 0]
